required_findings.why_required: This is not a request to invent or remove an original finite law. It is a contradiction in the new source-claim/documentary-oracle contract used to interpret and report the successor. A no-numeric comparator cannot simultaneously promise the explicit numeric result in its expected field. Mechanical passing/null actual status does not resolve that ambiguity.
minimal_remedy_options: Create a preserved successor leaving every R1/R2 file, original_documentary_predicate, source_claim, old IDs/actions and actual null/U status intact. Set the affected new documentary_expected/comparator pairs null and retain those results as historical source claims, then update current counts, prose, exact delta, snapshots/seal and read-only checks.

Alternatively, where the exact existing source/finite scope is independently supported, explicitly classify only that finite inherited documentary numeric subset and supply a consistent source-limited comparator; qualify the blanket null/UI-only prose and reporting labels accordingly, without expanding numeric laws or actual/target grades.
required_findings.required_fixture: Add a focused negative fixture that rejects a numeric documentary expected value paired with a no-numeric comparator or an inaccurate all-numeric-null/visible-only summary; preserve the current productive guard fixtures.
